evidence_summary.accuracy_note: Accuracy above 75% is not evidence of skill here: on these high-hunger quarters a rule that always says HIGH scores 0.925 at lead 1.
evidence_summary.statement: No forecast is validated. On the examined 2021-2026 quarters no model beats every baseline (persistence, calibrated persistence, always-HIGH, climatology, the Chapter I baselines), and no sealed forecast has an authorized outcome yet (0 unseen quarters scored). Every probability below is an experimental estimate.

label_definition: S1 = H + 2D; HIGH if S1 > tau (median of the S1 labels published before the origin)
